title: Context compaction
summary: Long conversations compact automatically near the model’s context limit. Check the status and resend a rejected message when ready.

workflows.label: Check and compact
workflows.summary: Inspect the state, preview the size of a reduction, or compact the current conversation now.

entry.prerequisite: Use the conversation whose history needs to be reduced.

steps.action: Run /compact status, or read the status banner in the Web UI.
steps.expect: It distinguishes compacting, paused, failed and ready to retry.

steps.action: Use /compact preview for a non-mutating estimate.
steps.expect: It reports recent and pinned messages kept, summarizable message counts and an estimated token reduction; it does not show a proposed summary.

steps.action: Let automatic compaction finish, or use /compact now to start immediately. Use /compact to ask the model what to keep first.
If a request was rejected for context size, wait for ready to retry and send your message again.
steps.expect: Kollab does not automatically replay the failed request.

commands.description: Preview a possible compaction before changing conversation history.
Compact immediately without asking what to keep.
commands.expect: Older history is summarized to make room for later turns.

media.alt: Kollab chat showing Context reduction ready and the instruction to resend the last message
media.caption: When the banner says context reduction is ready, resend the message yourself.

workflows.success: Kollab reduces the current conversation history and leaves a summary for continued work.

recovery.action: Read the next action in the banner or /compact status. Resolve that issue before retrying; keep important decisions in a concise note.

recovery.symptom: A provider rejects the request because its context is too large
recovery.action: The failed request is not resent automatically. Run /compact now or start a smaller conversation, then explicitly send the request again.

recovery.symptom: Compaction cannot run while another turn is active
recovery.action: Wait for or stop that turn, inspect /compact status, then retry /compact now.

workflows.note: Compaction changes conversation history. Review the summary and resend your original request yourself; Kollab does not automatically replay the failed request.
